title: Register transfer loop
statement: Let $C,d,x_0,a,b,e,p$ be natural numbers, and let $x$ be a finite binary input. In the five-register counter program specified by the front-end instruction table with parameters $C,d$, start at the branch that tests the third register, with registers $(x_0,a,b,0,e)$, input position $p$, and any previously printed output $o$. Within at most $3b+1$ steps, the program reaches the branch that tests the fifth register, with registers $(x_0,a+b,0,0,e)$, the same input position $p$, and output still $o$.
